MERGE INTO CHB_PRD_PERIODYIELD CII USING (
SELECT '${item.seqno}' SEQNO, '${item.fprodId}'null FPROD_ID, '${item.prodId}' PROD_ID, #{item.changeDate,jdbcType=DATE}null CHANGE_DATE, '${item.changType}' CHANG_TYPE, ${item.prodValue}null PROD_VALUE, '${item.orgCode}' ORG_CODE, '${item.deptCode}' DEPT_CODE, '${item.status}' STATUS, #{item.revDate,jdbcType=DATE}null REV_DATE, '${item.dataSource}' DATA_SOURCE, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, current timestamp UPDATE_TIME, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, current timestamp CREATE_TIME, '${item.remark}' REMARK, ${item.unitValueTotal}null UNIT_VALUE_TOTAL, '${item.ccy}' ccy FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
) TEMP
ON(CII.PROD_ID = TEMP.PROD_ID AND CII.CHANGE_DATE = TEMP.CHANGE_DATE AND CII.CHANG_TYPE = TEMP.CHANG_TYPE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.PROD_VALUE = TEMP.PROD_VALUE, CII.UNIT_VALUE_TOTAL = TEMP.UNIT_VALUE_TOTAL, CII.ORG_CODE = TEMP.ORG_CODE, CII.DEPT_CODE = TEMP.DEPT_CODE, CII.REV_DATE = TEMP.REV_DATE, CII.STATUS = decode(TEMP.STATUS,'E','M','D'), CII.REMARK = TEMP.REMARK, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.CCY = TEMP.CCY
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SEQNO, FPROD_ID, PROD_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANG_TYPE, PROD_VALUE, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, STATUS, REV_DATE, DATA_SOURCE, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, REMARK,UNIT_VALUE_TOTAL,CCY) VALUES(TEMP.SEQNO, TEMP.FPROD_ID, TEMP.PROD_ID, TEMP.CHANGE_DATE, TEMP.CHANG_TYPE, TEMP.PROD_VALUE, TEMP.ORG_CODE, TEMP.DEPT_CODE, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.REV_DATE, TEMP.DATA_SOURCE, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.REMARK,TEMP.UNIT_VALUE_TOTAL,TEMP.CCY)
